sourceDataFlowReview.observed: Only events.owned and calendars.readonly OAuth scopes; primary calendar identifier retained; refresh token AES-GCM sealed with tenant/connection AAD. Disconnect nulls refresh/increments epoch and preserves other row fields; no Google revoke/event delete.

Jobs copy separate saved visit facts and event references, generate deterministic managed event bodies, and read/update/delete only identified visit events with ownership checks. Disconnected getCalendarConnection returns null; queued work waits rather than obtaining a refresh token. No unrelated-event listing or free/busy import observed.

Supported self-service visits use portal-only saved records and background Calendar delivery, without adding inline Google event results to the tool return. Model input is separately supplied system/messages/tool facts; this Calendar connection stores OAuth data in separate server-side rows, not model messages.
Netlify JSON connection/sync records with no general automatic deletion schedule. Sealed refresh token does not imply all records encrypted by that mechanism.
